messages:
oliver_fin: Heads-up: Channel partner NorthBridge flagged an unexpected credit on their March AWS marketplace settlement. The invoice shows they were billed at the Tier 1 rate but the marketplace settlement used Tier 2 pricing for 2024-03-10 to 2024-03-12. Net delta ~ $4,430 chargeback. Can infra confirm mapping? @yasmin_ops

yasmin_ops: Pulling the marketplace export and our price ladder mapping now. Link to AWS export: s3://billing/aws/exports/2024-03/northbridge_march.csv

aws_marketplace_bot: AWS marketplace export available: aws-mktplace-2024-03-northbridge.csv

yasmin_ops: Quick check: our pricing ladder code matches using effective_rate_id, but I see two rate_ids for the same sku: rate-abc (tier1) and rate-abc-v2 (tier2). The marketplace export used rate-abc-v2 for 72 hours. Looks like a rate rollover on their side.

tony_channel_pm: NorthBridge says they performed a SKU entitlement update on 2024-03-09 23:58 UTC to enable higher throughput, which triggered the new rate ID. They expected rollout on 03-13, not immediately.

oliver_fin: So customer charged at higher tier in marketplace but our invoice stayed at old tier? That explains the credit. We need to compute retro reconciliation and request partner confirmation for adjustment.

yasmin_ops: I'll run a reconciliation allowing multiple rate_id mappings and produce a diff. SQL: `SELECT customer_id, sku, rate_id, SUM(units) FROM aws_usage WHERE date BETWEEN '2024-03-10' AND '2024-03-12' GROUP BY 1,2,3;`

yasmin_ops: Uploaded diff: https://files.redwood/finance/reconciliations/northbridge_mar_rate_rollover_diff.csv. Delta = $4,430 (we owe credit).

tony_channel_pm: I pinged NorthBridge and they acknowledged the premature rollout and agreed to accept the credit. They asked us to avoid auto-rebilling and to record the offset on next invoice.

finance-approvals: Noted. For credits < $5k standard approval path OK. Required: partner ack + CSV diff + AR ticket.

oliver_fin: Creating AR ticket AR-2024-0490 and attaching artifacts. Will schedule credit offset on April invoice if approvals complete.

yasmin_ops: I'll add a guard to mapping logic to prefer explicit effective_rate_id matching and to log rate_id rollovers; task INF-1355.

oliver_fin: Thanks all. Closing once AR-2024-0490 is confirmed processed.
